Preparing for Creative Industries (A): Real World Encounters

In this module, you’ll explore real‑world workplaces within the creative communication industry, gaining insight into how agencies and in‑house teams operate, collaborate, and shape professional culture. You’ll analyse industry briefs, hear from expert speakers, and investigate how creative companies define their values and differentiate themselves in a competitive landscape. Alongside this, you’ll develop your professional branding and portfolio, and advance your pitching and networking skills to align your university journey with your emerging career goals. These experiences will support your assessments and lay confident groundwork for your progression into Preparing for Creative Industries (B).

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Apply knowledge on business and management principles suitable for further study.

+  Demonstrate understanding of key contemporary business concepts.

+  Gain the ability to analyse the business external environment.
